hotspots.title: Salvini’s Roggero prison visit sparks outrage
hotspots.blurb: Matteo Salvini's high-profile visit to imprisoned jeweler Mario Roggero, convicted of killing two robbers, has ignited a political firestorm. The Lega leader's advocacy for Roggero's pardon and potential candidacy has drawn sharp criticism from opposition parties and legal experts, who accuse Salvini of exploiting the case for political gain.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot commands disproportionate attention due to its moral and legal ambiguity, blending themes of justice, self-defense, and political opportunism in a highly polarized context.

hotspots.title: Tisza-government’s constitutional overhaul sparks backlash
hotspots.blurb: Hungary's new Tisza-led government has pushed through sweeping constitutional amendments, including the forced resignation of President Tamás Sulyok. The reforms, aimed at dismantling Viktor Orbán's legacy, have triggered accusations of authoritarianism from Fidesz and raised concerns about judicial independence and democratic norms.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to its high-stakes political maneuvering, perceived threats to democratic institutions, and the intense polarization between the ruling Tisza party and opposition Fidesz.
